Try out these 10 Weight Vest Exercises for cricket players.
These are dynamic body weight training exercises weigh an added weighted vest to add resistance to the workout.
It is important that a cricket player has good strength to help with performance.
Track: Clarx, Catas, Le Malls, CHENDA, Anikdote, Numb The Pain (feat. Shiah Maisel) (NCS 10 Release)
Music provided by NoCopyRightSounds.
